'''''Life Day Matriarch''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] made sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. It was part of a series of three paintings, alongside ''[[Life Day Kashyyyk]]'' and ''[[Life Day Patriarch]]'', that were made for the festivities of [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]]. The painting in question depicted a female Wookiee howling to the winds. It was supplied during the events of an annual Life Day celebration on Kashyyyk.

==Behind the scenes==
''Life Day Matriarch'', alongside ''Life Day Patriarch'' and ''Life Day Kashyyyk'', were supplied randomly to players who chose a painting instead of a Life Day orb, although they could skip both altogether if they only asked for a robe and were also Wookiees. As of 2005, it is no longer available, and thus is considered a collector's item.
